title: Train every student in one command, and see each beside its rule
request: Phase 7 (the owner): a student behind every choice; 29.4: train everything, one command.
plan: --all: every generation's points, a student or a reason it has none in SKIPPED.json.
--compare: every student beside its rule on dev, from the cards.
One point failing never costs the others.

decisions.decision: A point with too few rows, one class, or labels whose fields are not excluded gets a reason, not a model.
decisions.why: A student trained on nothing it can learn from would whisper noise beside a rule.

change: decision_models_build: GENERATIONS, why_not, build_all, compare, --all and --compare.
outcome: One command trains or explains every student, and one prints them all beside their rules.
lessons: A batch over many points must keep going past a point that fails, and say why.
risks: A full run retrains every generation: about half an hour on the Mac.
